mutations.name: a phone gets the knowledge table instead of cards
kills: the knowledge list on a phone stacks each note into a card with its title, kind, initiative and file instead of the table

mutations.name: a desktop gets knowledge cards instead of the table
kills: the knowledge list on a phone keeps the table on a desktop

mutations.name: a knowledge card's links keep only their text's height
kills: the knowledge list on a phone gives each card's title and initiative links a 44px tap target

mutations.name: the record breadcrumb's rows keep their full width
kills: a knowledge record on a phone lets its long ref break inside the breadcrumb instead of widening the page
